svg.text: Real CLI run · synthetic demo data
$ templateparity demo --json
"experiment_id": "synthetic-demo",
"json": "./.templateparity/runs/synthetic-demo.json",
"markdown": "./.templateparity/runs/synthetic-demo.md",
"label": "Synthetic demonstration \u2014 not measured model inference."
$ templateparity report synthetic-demo
# Captured report excerpt from the generated artifact
Mode: native
Compatibility: synthetic; no tokenizer claim
The fabricated example shows a prompt, assistant-prefix, BOS, stop-policy, and output difference. It demonstrates
report behavior only; it is not measured inference.
- TP001 (warning) Rendered prompt text differs. The runtimes serialize the logical conversation differently.
Suggested: Inspect the text diff and run a shared-input control.
- TP003 (warning) An inserted or deleted token in the aligned sequence is identified as BOS by tokenizer metadata. BOS
handling differs for this observed input. Suggested: Compare native template tokenization with text tokenization and
check for duplicate BOS.
- TP005 (info) Assistant header/prefix text is not identical. Generation may begin from different assistant prefixes.
Suggested: Inspect the final rendered prompt segment.
Synthetic token IDs and outputs demonstrate report behavior; no model inference was run.
